title: Publish portfolio to Firebase Hosting Spark
summary: Built the reviewed GitHub source in Firebase Cloud Shell, verified a preview release, and promoted the same version to live on Spark.
outcome: The live homepage and seven case-study routes returned HTTP 200, a missing case study returned 404, and Persian mode switched the live page to right-to-left. Cloud identity was restricted to the GitHub Actions workflow on main.
decisions: Authenticated GitHub Actions with short-lived Workload Identity Federation grants restricted to the portfolio workflow on main.
An upload retry with concurrency set to four successfully completed the Firebase preview.
next_actions: Verify the first automated main-branch GitHub Actions release after merging.
evidence: Firebase Hosting preview version 414c3bbcae4d1655 was promoted to live.
